scripts.build:desktop: cd apps/desktop && bun run tauri build
scripts.build:windows: cd apps/desktop && bun run tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.build:extension-firefox: bun run build:extension && bun run scripts/build-extension-firefox.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.check:all: bun run check && bun run e2e:extension
scripts.dev:desktop: cd apps/desktop && bun run tauri dev
scripts.e2e:extension:setup: ./scripts/dev-server.sh start && bun run seed && bun run build:extension
